historical_reviews.deepseek: Cannot prove tool-mode severity, physical target or post-reset BERT attribution.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds recovery but assumes UCE semantics from title/prose rather than authoritative flag documentation.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row 52 uses the same errortype 0 with errormode 1 for CE. Thus errormode may control parity severity, but that must be documented rather than inferred. Row 54 uses errortype 2/errormode 0 with UECC Retry.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Immediate-reset injection requires pre-approved severity mapping, reset deadline and durable pre/post evidence.

original_test_intent: Inject an uncorrectable RCD/DRAM parity error on each required memory target, verify the designed immediate warm reset and an attributable post-boot BERT record, then prove successful recovery and restored configuration.
original_method: Obtain vendor mapping for dramothererrors errortype/errormode; correct the list syntax; map RCD/DIMM slots to socket/die/UMC/channel/rank; capture durable pre-state and OOB console; inject one approved UCE target; timestamp tool dispatch to reset, firmware/boot and BERT record; verify BERT source/severity/location matches the target and no boot loop or persistent parity state remains; restore RCD/MCA/injection/HDT state before separately approving another target.
manual_activity: The FAE approves flag-to-UCE semantics and target, executes one immediate-reset injection under OOB observation, recovers the SUT, validates BERT and restores all RAS/HDT state.
required_inputs: Vendor-correct listvalidumc syntax and tool/spec version/hash/license
Authoritative mapping of dramothererrors errortype 0 plus errormode 0 to parity UCE/immediate reset
Slot/RCD to socket/die/UMC/channel/rank map and approved replacement/meaning of 0:0:3
Exact BERT CPER source/severity/location/syndrome oracle and log persistence path
Maximum dispatch-to-reset, boot and OS-ready deadlines plus permitted recovery
RCD Parity/MCA/Reset After Sync-Flood before/target/after values, abort and restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated backed-up SUT with independent console/power/reimage and verified boot media
Preserve logs and stage durable/OOB capture before injection because host output may stop immediately
One mapped UCE only; do not repeat after reset without evidence review and new approval
Abort on wrong target/severity, no reset beyond deadline, boot loop, missing BERT, persistent parity or lost console
No automatic reset/retry/recovery; disable injection and restore RAS/HDT state
agent_execution_scope: Validate command syntax, severity flags, topology, BERT decoder and recovery readiness
Collect read-only pre-state, OOB reset/boot timeline, BERT/CPER, BMC/UEFI and post-health evidence
Do not correct flags by analogy, change BIOS/HDT, inject, power-cycle/reimage/retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve UCE mode and physical target
Define exact immediate-reset and BERT acceptance
Supervise one injection and boot recovery
Clear injector, restore settings and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic dmesg/MCA grep may be lost at reset and cannot prove BERT CPER corresponds to the selected parity UCE.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use vendor-approved syntax and flag mapping for one target, capture continuous OOB reset/boot evidence, then decode the post-boot BERT record to the same source/location/severity.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: errortype 0, tuple 0:0:3, mcapolling 0, errormode 0, immediate reset, BERT, correctable line and 60/120 minutes are preserved as source facts requiring reconciliation.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run one mapped parity UCE as a reset transaction with durable pre-state, OOB timing and decoded BERT correlation after boot.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds flag authority, exact CPER oracle, reset/boot deadlines, serialized target approval and restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An immediate reset alone does not prove the intended parity UCE; the post-boot record must map back to the commanded target.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong mode may produce CE, fatal behavior other than planned reset, boot failure or missing volatile evidence.

project_override_considerations: If errormode 0 is the authoritative UCE selector while errortype 0 names parity subtype, cite that tool revision. Otherwise the source command must be corrected through an approved execution package, not guessed from the title.
expected_evidence: Exact identity, corrected syntax and flag-to-UCE authority
Approved slot/RCD/UMC target and BIOS/HDT pre-state
Full command dispatch plus continuous OOB reset/boot timeline
Decoded post-boot BERT/CPER source, severity, location and timestamp correlated to injection
BMC/UEFI and OS-ready/memory-health evidence with no residual parity
Injection disablement, restored configuration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row calls the event parity UCE and predicts immediate reset, but uses errortype 0 also used in the adjacent CE row; only errormode differs and semantics are undocumented. Criteria still includes correctable PASS. The list command is malformed, 0:0:3 cannot prove slot 1~N, and reset/OS timeouts are undefined.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Parity UCE, immediate reset and BERT intent are identifiable. Engineering can supply flag mapping, target and reset oracle, so static review completes while execution is gated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 53 Wistron-System RAS-00773-V002: provide vendor authority that dramothererrors errortype=0/errormode=0 selects parity UCE and reconcile the correctable Criteria line; correct listvalidumc syntax; provide slot/RCD-to-socket/die/UMC/channel/rank coverage and approve/correct 0:0:3; define immediate-reset, boot and OS deadlines plus exact BERT/CPER source/severity/location oracle, aborts, OOB recovery, injector cleanup and restoration.

review_improvement: Makes flag-to-severity authority and decoded BERT correlation mandatory, so an arbitrary reset or generic post-boot record cannot satisfy the parity-UCE case.
independent_technical_reasoning: The same errortype value appearing in CE and UCE cases suggests severity may be encoded by errormode, but adjacent usage is evidence of ambiguity, not proof. Immediate reset prevents reliable host-side collection, so the test must stage OOB timing and rely on a decoded persistent BERT/CPER record after boot. A reset without matching source/location could be an unrelated failure, and a correct BERT record without bounded boot recovery is incomplete containment evidence.
